Ultratech Cement Limited has informed the Exchange vide its letter dated October 06, 2009, that: "A meeting of the Board of Directors ("Board") of Ultratech Cement Limited (the "Company") was held in Mumbai today, at which the Board of the Company deliberated upon the proposal received from Samruddhi Cement Limited ("Samruddhi") in relation to a potential consolidation of Samruddhi and the Company. The Board, having found the proposal attractive, constituted and authorized a Committee of Directors and Officers of the Company to inter alia evaluate and consider the proposal in consultation with legal and financial advisors. The Committee is expected to revert to the Board with its recommendations by 1st week of November, 2009" .

Ultratech Cement Limited has informed the Exchange that: "The Board of Directors, at its meeting held on 12th March, 2007, declared interim dividend of Rs.4/- per equity shares (face value of Rs.10/- each) for the year 2006-07. At the meeting held on date (April 21, 2007), the Board has decided to treat interim dividend as final dividend for the year ended 31st March, 2007".
